**Meet Matt**

<div>

Matt is a doctoral student in the department of Planning, Public Policy and Management at the University of Oregon. His degree is in Planning and Public Affairs, with a focus on how regional governance frameworks can replicate just city principles through multi-level participatory processes. When not opening too many articles to counts, Matt enjoys spending time with his wife, two kids - biking around town, going to baseball games, or building community.
